note: RESEARCH pane of the OpenZone admin window -- its own pbo and its own layout, because a server without the research mod never loads this file and the core must not know the pane exists. OZL_VppPane.OnCreate builds it under M_SUB_WIDGET and calls RegisterPane(research, RESEARCH, pane, ResHint), so the root stands at [0, vpp.paneY] and starts hidden like the core panes. Names the script resolves by string: ResOwners, ResConfigs, ResPicked, ResStatics (FindAnyWidget) and GrantType, GrantN, NodeId (SetEdit/GetEdit); ResHint is resolved by the core from the hint name handed to RegisterPane. Buttons dispatched in OnClick: BtnRefresh, BtnReload, BtnReset, BtnGrant, BtnComplete, BtnEditCfg. Tokens come from the core repository through [build] tokens: the admin window is a platform surface. Console captions stay English.
